scope: Company directory, company profiles, company position lists and external recruitment links. Individual job-detail responses are outside this contract.

verified_endpoints.purpose: Enumerate the nationwide Waiqi company directory.

pagination.completion_rule: Deduplicate response page.records by company id and reconcile the unique count to response page.total. Do not trust response page.current, page.size or page.pages.

verified_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve company names, nature, scale, industry, introduction, website and city hints.

verification.warning: positionCount can be stale and must not be used to skip the position-list request.

verified_endpoints.purpose: Retrieve every position currently exposed on a Waiqi company page, including the external recruitment URL when present.

verification.warning: The list is a Waiqi reference surface, not the official ATS source of truth for whether a job is still open.

operational_notes: Use nationwide empty filters for the catalog; the website entry page defaults to Beijing.
Rate limits require serialized or low-concurrency crawling with Retry-After cooldown.
Store request metadata, fetched_at and the SHA256 of each raw response.
Refresh every company position list even when the company profile reports positionCount=0.
Do not fetch individual Waiqi job-detail endpoints for this asset scope.
